before.exam_tip_html: For any question comparing welding, brazing and soldering, the examiner is looking for you to identify: (1) whether the base metal melts, (2) the filler material and its melting point range, and (3) the resulting joint strength or application. A Mastering-level answer for a 6-mark question would also include a specific product example for each process and comment on the skill or equipment required. Do not just say a joint is “stronger” — explain why (e.g. “welding fuses the base metal, making the joint continuous with the parent material, whereas soldering only adheres a low-melting-point filler to the surface”).
